device.description: The block device path to monitor for disk activity (e.g., /dev/sda).

poll_interval.description: How often (in milliseconds) to check the motion sensor for movement.

sensitivity.description: Minimum movement amplitude (in arbitrary sensor units) required to trigger disk unloading. Lower = more sensitive.

unmount_enabled.description: If true, automatically unmounts protected filesystems when the laptop is moved.

protected_mounts.description: List of filesystems to protect. Each item specifies a mountpoint and its backing device (e.g., '/home:/dev/sda2'). Unmounted on motion detection if unmount_enabled is true.

kernel_modules.description: Optional list of kernel modules (e.g., 'thinkpad_acpi') that may provide sensor access. Add if hdapsd fails to detect sensors automatically.

debug.description: If true, enable verbose debug logging to syslog for troubleshooting.
